title: Echoes of Infection
description: A mod that adds zombie infection
body:
All players start as humans. After death, a player turns into an infected with negative effects. To cure yourself, eat a golden apple. The admin chooses one of three game modes that affect difficulty and rules.

### Modes:

**Fast** — Keep inventory on, instant respawn, infected have no debuffs, cure is disabled.

**Normal** — Keep inventory on, normal respawn, infected are slower, cure works.

**Long** — Keep inventory off, normal respawn, infected are slower, have mining fatigue and reduced health, cure works.

### Commands:
`/infection menu` — open mode selection menu

`/infection mode <fast|normal|long>` — set game mode

`/infection status` — show current mode and team stats

Inspired by [Zombie Infection](https://modrinth.com/datapack/zombieinfection/versions)
